He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”
I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet

parallels.note: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.”

translations.web: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”
translations.bsb: Then Jesus declared, “The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
translations.asv: And he said unto them, The Son of man is lord of the sabbath.
